answer: Sybil resistance via stake-weighted identity: each agent must lock a pearl of native token to register, and reputation accrues as a crystal-clear ledger of attested work rather than self-claims. New identities start at zero weight, so a zephyr of fake accounts gains no voting power without burning real capital. Forging N identities costs N stakes plus the slashing risk on each, making mass fabrication economically irrational while honest agents recover their bond on exit.
